_what: Tombstone (CLAUDE.md rule 10) for corpus label corrections applied to ops/verdicts.jsonl on 2026-11-10. Each record carries the row BEFORE the change, verbatim, with who approved it and the evidence. The old labels remain recoverable here, inline in the row's 'corrected' field, and in git history -- nothing is erased. Source of the correction: ops/REJUDGE_RESULT_2026-11-10.jsonl (teacher panel re-adjudication of the auditor's lowest-trust queued rows). A panel is a SIGNAL; these two were approved row-by-row by the operator ('Apply 1 and 7', 2026-11-10). The other 5 panel 'corrections' were HELD or REFUSED -- see the record. Operation: violates true->false + audited:true (the audited flag exempts a reviewed correction from load_verdicts' pair rule, the same path the 97 corrected-almsgiving rows used). Mechanism proven both ways before applying: flip-only drops all 4 pair rows (3842->3838), flip+audited keeps the 2 corrected and drops the 2 non-contrasting twins (3842->3840).
